page.layout: One printed page: a running head at the top, then one block of text with the heading, the approval paragraph and the censor's signature below it. No margin notes. A handwritten "295" sits at the top right and is not printed. The faint text under the printed text is show-through from the other side of the leaf.

main_text.l: I. Lipsij, clarissimi Louaniensis Academiæ Professoris, de Romana militia libros quinque, quos ad pri-scam illustrandam historiam erudite conscripsit, pro-bo, & prælo dignos censeo. Louanij Idibus Martijs 1594.
Henricus Cuyckius D. Petri Louanij Decanus, & Pontificius ac Regius librorum Censor.

page.notes: The "295" at the top right is handwritten and was left out. The running head is faint and blurred; the words could not be read, so it is marked as illegible. A faint mark at the bottom left is too unclear to read as a signature and was left out. The title line is set in italic with long s throughout, transcribed as plain s. The printed date "1 5 9 4" is spaced out in the original and is given here as 1594.
